164: The three-pointed blade of Erlang Shen, also known as Qingyuan Miaodao Zhenjun, a peerless warrior among the immortals. He slew many evil dragons, demon gods and spirits of nature.
166: It is said to unleash tremendous power every Monday at 8:45 p.m.
181: A staff made in a rather halfhearted fashion, somehow.
183: Clothes that look utterly devoid of enthusiasm, no matter how you look at them.
190: At the twilight of Melnibone's Empire of Light, which had flourished for ten thousand years, great upheavals shook heaven and earth. The fates of mortals and gods were forged upon the anvil of Destiny; terrible wars were fought and mighty deeds performed. Many heroes arose in those days, but greatest among them was Elric, the last emperor of Melnibone, bearer of the rune-carved black sword.
195: This hammer is said to let you recover stolen items.
207: An orichalcum sword handed down through generations of Dragon Knights, whose mission is to preserve the balance between the heavens, the earth and the demon realm. It belongs to the Dragon Master Baran.
208: The crowning achievement of Bruenor Battlehammer, chief of the Battlehammer dwarves and king of the legendary Mithral Hall. "I see," said Drizzt, handing the hammer back to Bruenor. "An old hammer. It might be just right for the boy, considering you went to the trouble of using mithril, adamantite and diamonds." (R. A. Salvatore, The Icewind Dale Trilogy; translated here from the Japanese description in the game.)
217: A player wearing this can repel curses.
250: A needle-like device implanted directly into the brain, bestowed by Galactic Emperor Kaldarm IV upon some of his followers. It is said to greatly enhance the recipient's abilities and even grant eternal youth and immortality. "Why did you have that implanted? As proof of loyalty? Or do you think it an honor to become a disposable terminal for a computer?" (Yuki Hijiri, Locke the Superman.)
270: "Well done! I feared the task might be impossible! You have returned with the Longbow of Diana! I now fear that the centaur will choose another great scorpion. That will happen someday, but if you can recover the Amulet of Yendor for Venus before then, we will be safe forever. Take the Longbow of Diana with you. It will aid you in your quest for the Amulet." (Orion, JNethack.)
